title: Protesters outside Portsmouth hotel mistake Pakistan U19 cricket team for asylum seekers
description:
• Reform councillor said he urged activists to stand down

  • ECB checks on young players’ welfare

A group of masked agitators gathered outside a four-star hotel in Portsmouth after reports a group of asylum seekers had been taken there, when it was in fact Pakistan’s under-19 cricket team on a tour.

George Madgwick, a Reform councillor called to the hotel to mediate between staff and the assembled crowd, said it was a “massively unfortunate incident”.
